reconstruction_notes.en: Original Sidneyia-inspired animal with short broad head, overlapping wide trunk shields, abruptly narrower ringed abdomen and paired tail paddles. Simple economical limbs, thin antennae and small lateral eyes. Body+tail0.14m is nominal art scale; exact limb/microhair counts, color, movement and predation animation are not claimed.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创 Sidneyia 启发教学动物：短宽头甲、宽叠甲躯干、突然收窄的环腹及双尾桨，配经济肢组、细触角与小侧眼。体尾0.14米为名义美术尺度；不声称精确肢节/微毛数量、真实颜色、运动或捕食动画。

description.en: Original low-poly direction: establish broad overlapping trunk plates taper abruptly into narrow rings and tail paddles in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
